note.text: Environment provenance correction: do not inherit or forward the invoking host shell environment wholesale. Populate the guest only with variables explicitly introduced or changed by the applicable project .envrc chain, including values loaded through source_up_if_present and ancestor .envrc files. An ambient host variable must not enter the VM merely because it exists; for example, an ambient OPENAI_API_KEY is excluded unless the applicable .envrc chain explicitly sets or changes OPENAI_API_KEY. The design must preserve variable provenance rather than infer it from the final host environment. It must not execute agent-writable .envrc or project Nix code on the host while establishing the VM boundary. Research and implement a safe mechanism that transports the applicable .envrc inputs as data and resolves them inside the guest or otherwise proves the exact .envrc-produced delta without ambient leakage. The resulting values must be materialized into the MicroVM user's ordinary login and Codex app-server environment so neither guest direnv nor an explicit nix develop step is required for normal use. Define refresh behavior when .envrc inputs change, handle unset/removal semantics, avoid persisting secrets in committed files or logs, and retain explicit rejection of values that attempt to expose prohibited host sockets, paths, devices, credentials, or services.
